what_to_look_for: Select a series and press Run (step 4)

expected_visual: Solid line up to the forecast-start boundary
Dashed mean line after the boundary
Two dashed amber lines (Lower 80% / Upper 80%) hugging the mean for first 30 days
Two dotted red lines (Lower 95% / Upper 95%) wider than 80% for first 30 days
No filled ribbon/arearange between bounds; lines only
Vertical boundary at last actual date
Interval lines visible only first 30 days; mean continues as point forecast afterwards
Amber 'Point anomaly' note appears in data notes; interval is proportional to the (anomalous) point
Green note: intervals backtest-calibrated, first 30 days only, longer windows point-forecast after day 30, Shiny only visualizes columns
Cells: Interval method, Interval source, Interval levels shown (80%, 95%), Calibrated horizon (1-30 days), Calibration grain, Calibration sample size
Note: intervals shown only through forecast day 30; later days point forecast only
When a series has no interval rows: point-forecast-only note shown
